chapter: Hopkins, the South and Stuff Smith
title: Dating the Stuff Smith period: Chicago, Hollywood, Jonah Jones
summary: He joined Stuff Smith around 1939, going to Chicago and then Hollywood in 1940, probably succeeding Jonah Jones as trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well when you went back, when you got together again with Fats, did you just stay with him for there still breaks quite a while then, or were you (inaudible)
Let me see, what are we talking about now, '42, until --
This was steady then, from there on then.
Um, more or less. He left -- he left again to go do 'Stormy Weather', and whatnot, and --
Well was that when you -- when you joined Stuff Smith?
Uh, yes. I -- no, I joined Stuff Smith in '39, because we went from here to Chicago, and did so many
months there, and from there we went to Hollywood, and in '40, or in certainly in '40, or '40, I was in California, in '42, we came back from California.
Oh. So there was what, period of three years when you were with Stuff?
No, it wasn't -- oh, because I'm trying to think now, must have been late thirties then, because '40 we were at the Freyvilla Frugal Club in Hollywood.
No, No I didn't replace -- well, Jonah wasn't there. Let me see, I'm trying to think who -- who had been there? Okay, I guess it was Jonah. I can't think of another -- another --
But you came in more or less at the time that he left. He must have -- he joined Cab about '39, I think, '39, '40.
Well I think Jonah was the last -- maybe Jonah was the last trumpet player he had before me, could be, like that, you know?
